title: Expressive
summary: EXPRESS'IVE, adjective Serving to express; serving to utter or represent; followed by of. He sent a letter couched in terms expressive of his gratitude. Each verse so swells expressive of her woes. 1.

inlines.v: EXPRESS'IVE, adjective Serving to express; serving to utter or represent; followed by of. He sent a letter couched in terms expressive of his gratitude. Each verse so swells expressive of her woes. 1. Representing with force; emphatical. These words are very expressive 2. Showing; representing; as an expressive sign.
